recognize_zh: 骨髓切片免疫染色中大量棕色陽性的漿細胞呈間質散在與小團聚集，許多細胞中央有大型透明圓形包涵體、周圍一圈染色，像戒指般，代表胞質內充滿免疫球蛋白的 Russell body，提示漿細胞增生。
features: Numerous immunoreactive (brown) plasma cells scattered interstitially and in small clusters
Many positive cells contain large round clear globular inclusions with a rim of staining (Russell bodies)
Positive cells vary in size, some markedly enlarged by the inclusions
Negative background hematopoietic cells with blue hematoxylin counterstain
Fat spaces preserved; the specific antibody is not labeled in the image
describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy immunostain for a plasma cell marker (antibody not specified; pattern compatible with CD138 or a light chain) highlights increased plasma cells distributed interstitially and in small clusters. Many plasma cells contain large, round cytoplasmic globular inclusions consistent with Russell bodies, producing a ring-like staining pattern. The remaining hematopoietic cells are negative. Findings support a plasma cell proliferation with Russell body formation; quantification of plasma cells, kappa/lambda light chain staining to demonstrate monotypia and correlation with serum paraprotein are needed to establish plasma cell myeloma.

ddx.vs: Reactive plasma cells are perivascular and polytypic for kappa and lambda, whereas myeloma shows clustered or sheet-like monotypic plasma cells often exceeding 10% of cellularity.
LPL shows paratrabecular/interstitial small lymphocytes and plasmacytoid lymphocytes with IgM paraprotein and MYD88 L265P, rather than a pure plasma cell population.

ddx.dx: Signet ring cell carcinoma or lipid-laden macrophages
ddx.vs: Signet ring cells are keratin-positive with mucin vacuoles and macrophages are CD68/CD163 positive, while Russell body cells are CD138 and light chain positive.
